question: In a certain code language, 'EAGLE' is written as 'DZFKD' and 'DREAM' is written as 'CQDZL'. How will 'SINCE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'EAGLE' is written as 'DZFKD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61ef38243e5ddbd9daeda35f12429d549264dd6eb68c494e5d7104f4e13afc14.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbe91935d73eca905206b4c661ca8f595ea34deacc7ff061c5fb8b8ae9555ad5.png] 

And,

'DREAM' is written as 'CQDZL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb7352fac14b45bfdeaabf8790eafe78e17471184343211bced75755ccd8fcfd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/230e9f5ca20f6e5e3b17b8d3667dcffad8d4b437ed9b347ce9b2690f9244d0e1.png] 

Similarly,

'SINCE' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afe15adba1eac1a0e10633749b2421ed220f8400465769a3874665e6f69e413b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/278f754e517fab5e06283fafb4aeec4df6d958c45680e2202b32e0a06f190f19.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
